# Keep Calendar properties dialog tied to its subscription window

The calendar properties dialog can outlive the subscription window that opened it. Close the properties dialog if its opener closes; if the dialog itself closes, remove the observer and refresh the calendar name and color in the list.

Scope: calendar.

Paths:

- `calendar/base/content/dialogs/calendar-creation.js`

## Evidence

[Shared lesson record](../records/2dc065e5528a71ed0d246a8e15997735257b24e1b05e0e9cc7158ef7f3fd0620.json).

~~~
